featured_reviews.name: Harsh Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience with H T Motors was extremely disappointing from start to finish. This has honestly been one of the worst places I’ve dealt with when it comes to buying a vehicle. The staff did not seem genuinely interested in helping, and I often felt ignored or rushed instead of supported.
The communication was poor, with unclear answers and very little transparency during the process. Simple questions felt like a burden to them. The whole experience felt disorganized and stressful, which is the opposite of what you expect when making such a big purchase.
I walked in with high expectations but left frustrated and regretful. Customer service and professionalism were seriously lacking in my experience. There are many other dealerships that treat customers with more respect and patience.
Based on my personal experience, I would not recommend H T Motors to others. I hope they improve their service and how they treat customers in the future.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Respected Sir,

Thank you for providing such detailed feedback regarding your experience at HT MOTORS. We are genuinely sorry to hear that we fell short of the high standards of service and professionalism we aim to provide.
It is disappointing to learn that you felt ignored and that our communication lacked the transparency you deserved during such a significant purchase. This is not the experience we want for our customers, and we are using your comments to address these internal service gaps with our team.
We would appreciate the chance to speak with you directly to learn more and see how we can make things right. Please reach out to our management team at 7208566551/8850884542/connecthtmotors@gmail.com 

Sincerely,
The Management Team at HT MOTORS

featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience with Nafees Motors. I purchased a 2-month-old Suzuki Burgman from them at a very high price, as the dealer assured me that the scooter’s condition was “as good as brand new.” Unfortunately, the quality turned out to be far from that. The scooter makes excessive noise and feels unstable while riding. On top of that, the tyre appears to be defective — multiple tyre repairers have confirmed that it cannot be repaired and needs to be replaced, which is unacceptable for a scooter that was claimed to be in near-new condition.

When I confronted the dealer the very next day, he said he would take the scooter back but only after deducting ₹10,000, which felt completely unreasonable. What was even more disappointing was his change in behavior. Before the purchase he was very polite and soft-spoken, but after the sale and once I raised these issues, his attitude changed drastically.

I would strongly advise others to be cautious and thoroughly inspect the vehicle before buying from this dealer.
